findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed no paper towels to be present in bathroom. Discussed with PIC, paper towels will be brought to bathroom. Ensure paper towels are present in bathrooms.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed no test strips to be available during inspection. Discussed with PIC, test strips will be purchased. Ensure test strips are available during all hours of operations.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.116 Warewashing Equipment, Determining Chemical Sanitizer Concentration. Concentration of the SANITIZING solution shall be accurately determined by using a test kit or other device.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed popcorn ceiling to be present in dish room. Discussed with PIC, ceiling will be replaced. Ensure ceiling surfaces are smooth, easily cleanable, and non absorbent.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed caulking along the top of cove base under hand sink to be missing. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure caulking is present at any gaps in coving.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
